net.agent_unreachable.help: The network service of the device is not reachable, so nothing was changed. Wait a minute and reload this page; if it stays like this, restart the device (unplug it briefly). The current network settings stay in effect.
net.busy: The network service did not answer in time – the device may still be applying the change. Reload this page in a moment: if “Keep the new network settings?” appears, confirm it.
net.config_error.text: unreadable – Ethernet with automatic address only
net.country.help: Required for Wi-Fi. Choose where the device is used; it is never detected automatically.
net.err.bad_request: request not understood – reload the page and try again
net.err.forbidden: refused by the network service – restart the device
net.err.not_a_regular_file: is not a regular file – save again; if this repeats, restart the device
net.err.same_as_wifi: must differ from the Wi-Fi network name
net.err.too_large: too large – reload the page and save again
net.err.unreadable: could not be read – save again; if this repeats, restart the device
net.err.unsupported: format not supported by this version – save the settings again on this page
net.err.wrong_owner: belongs to the wrong user – save again; if this repeats, restart the device
net.fallback_in: opens in {seconds} s if the Wi-Fi does not connect
net.firewall.applied: active (only the web interface, the stream and name service are reachable)
net.firewall.failed: could not be applied – see diagnostics
net.hotspot.help: The hotspot opens only when no Wi-Fi or Ethernet connection works (after about a minute), never together with the Wi-Fi connection. Its clients reach only this setup page.
net.hotspot.none: No setup hotspot is configured: without a working network the device is reachable over Ethernet only.
net.hotspot.password_help: 12 to 63 characters. Note it down: there is no hotspot without a password you know.
net.hotspot.password_keep: Leave empty to keep the stored password (12 to 63 characters for a new one).
net.hotspot.remove_confirm: Remove the setup hotspot and its password?
net.hotspot.remove_help: Without the hotspot, a device without a working network can only be reached over Ethernet or restored with the SD card.
net.hotspot.title: Setup hotspot and country
net.hotspot.title.summary: Wi-Fi region and the fallback hotspot
net.ip.confirm: Apply the new addresses? You may have to open the page at the new address and confirm within 3 minutes, otherwise they are undone.
net.ip.dns_help: Up to three, separated by spaces.
net.ip.help: A wrong fixed address cannot lock you out: unconfirmed changes are undone after 3 minutes, and a 'hifi-recovery' file with 'network-reset' on the SD card restores automatic addresses.
net.ip.title: Addresses (IPv4/IPv6)
net.reason.no_address: Connected, but no address was assigned (DHCP).
net.reason.not_confirmed: The change was not confirmed in time, so the previous settings are active again.
net.reason.not_found: The Wi-Fi network was not found (out of range, switched off, or the name is different).
net.reason.rejected: The access point refused the connection.
net.reason.timeout: The connection did not come up in time.
net.reason.wrong_password: The Wi-Fi password was not accepted.
net.retry_in: in about {minutes} min (only while no device uses the hotspot)
net.saved_pending: New network settings are active – please confirm them.
net.scan.failed: The search could not be started.
net.scan.started: Searching for networks – the list updates in a few seconds.
net.scan.unsupported: Searching is not possible right now (the radio is busy as a hotspot). Enter the network name below.
net.setup.hint: Not connected to your home network yet – for example only to the device's setup hotspot, or no Ethernet cable? Then no Lyrion server can be found.
net.setup.note: The setup is not finished yet. After joining your home Wi-Fi, connect your phone to the same Wi-Fi, open the device's page again (its name or the address your router shows), confirm the new network settings and continue with the setup.
net.time.not_synced: not synchronised yet ({now}) – certificates are re-checked after the first synchronisation
net.title: Network
net.trial.had_address: The device had reached the new network as {addresses} – try that address next time.
net.trial.text: If you can read this page over the new connection, keep the settings. Otherwise the device returns to the previous settings by itself.
net.trial.title: Keep the new network settings?
net.trial.too_late: There is no change waiting for confirmation (it may have been undone already).
net.unmanaged.help: This installation has no network service of its own (for example the Docker lab). The addresses are shown; changes are made on the host.
net.wifi.forget_confirm: Forget the Wi-Fi network? If you are connected through it, the device may become unreachable until it opens the setup hotspot.
net.wifi.hidden_help: Only for networks that do not announce their name.
net.wifi.join_confirm: Connect to this network? While the setup hotspot is active it closes now: join the same Wi-Fi with your phone and open this page again. If that fails, the hotspot returns.
net.wifi.password_help: 8 to 63 characters (WPA2/WPA3 Personal). It is stored on the device only and never shown again.
net.wifi.password_keep: Leave empty to keep the stored password of the same network.
net.wifi.title: Wi-Fi
wizard.net.failed.hotspot: The setup hotspot is active again and you are connected through it. Check the network and the password and try again below, or skip this step.
wizard.net.failed.online: The device keeps its current connection.
wizard.net.failed.retry: Check the network and the password and try again below, or skip this step.
wizard.net.next.fail_hotspot: If it does not work, nothing is lost: the device restores the previous settings by itself – after about a minute if the Wi-Fi does not connect (for example a wrong password), otherwise after 3 minutes without confirmation – and the hotspot {hotspot} returns. Join it again and open {address}: this page then says what went wrong.
wizard.net.next.fail_wifi: If it does not work, nothing is lost: the device returns to {ssid} by itself – after about a minute if the new Wi-Fi does not connect, otherwise after 3 minutes without confirmation. Open this page again at its usual address: it then says what went wrong.
wizard.net.next.keep: The device joins the Wi-Fi; the result shows on this page.
wizard.net.next.keep_ethernet: The Ethernet connection stays as it is and this page stays reachable; the device joins the Wi-Fi in addition. The result shows on this page.
wizard.net.next.lose_hotspot: The setup hotspot {hotspot} closes and this page loses its connection. That is expected.
wizard.net.next.lose_wifi: The device leaves the Wi-Fi {ssid} and this page loses its connection. That is expected.
wizard.net.next.open: Open {url} (or the address your router lists for {name}) and log in. Press “Keep settings” within 3 minutes – the setup then continues where you left it.
wizard.net.next.rejoin: Connect your phone or computer to the Wi-Fi you chose here.
wizard.net.next.title: What happens when you press “Connect”
wizard.net.no_wifi: No Wi-Fi hardware was found. Connect the device with an Ethernet cable and reload this page.
wizard.net.offline.connecting: The device is trying to join the Wi-Fi “{ssid}” …
wizard.net.offline.hotspot: You are connected through the device's setup hotspot “{ssid}”. Choose your home Wi-Fi so the device can join it.
wizard.net.offline.none: The device is not connected to a network yet. Choose your Wi-Fi below, or plug in an Ethernet cable and reload this page.
wizard.net.online.host: Connected to the network as {address} (managed by the host system).
wizard.net.pending.help: After “Keep settings” the setup continues with the next step.
wizard.net.skip.help: Without the home network the next steps cannot find a Lyrion server. You can come back to this step at any time during the setup, or use Settings → Network later.
wizard.net.text: The bridge plays through your Lyrion server, so it needs your home network. Choose how the device connects; the rest of the setup continues afterwards.
wizard.net.title: Home network
wizard.net.unmanaged: The network of this installation is managed by the host system (for example the Docker lab), so there is nothing to set up here.
wizard.net.wifi_anyway.help: For example if the device should later work without the cable. The Ethernet connection stays as it is.
wizard.net.wifi_other.help: The device then leaves the current Wi-Fi. Read the steps above the Connect button first.
